For a new Indian software Pvt Ltd, I’d compare after-sales support more than the headline incorporation fee:

Provider	Warranty / issue resolution	After-sales support	Verdict
Vakilsearch	Support for incorporation delays, DSC/document issues via ticketing	Strong ongoing MCA compliance packages; from ~₹6,988/year currently	Best overall for founders wanting continuity 
Vakilsearch
+1

IndiaFilings	Dedicated relationship manager; document validation and incorporation support	MCA compliance, GST and other services available after incorporation	Best for hands-on support 
IndiaFilings
+1

ClearTax	Better suited to tax/software support than incorporation-specific remediation	Strong if you already use ClearTax for tax/GST/accounting	Best ecosystem, weaker standalone incorporation fit 
Vakilsearch

My pick: Vakilsearch for a typical software startup; IndiaFilings if you want a relationship manager and broader hand-holding. Before paying, get the written refund/rework policy for MCA rejection or provider-caused errors.
